projection.name: snowflake
projection.title: Snowflake
projection.description: Snowflake cockpit with databases, schemas, tables, views, warehouses, roles, grants, users, stages, pipes, tasks, streams, query history, credit metrics, and a SQL editor.

fields.label: Account identifier
fields.help: Organization and account name, or the legacy locator such as xy12345.us-east-1.

fields.label: Account hostname
fields.help: Hostname the gateway connects to. Usually the account identifier plus snowflakecomputing.com; use the privatelink or region hostname when yours differs.

fields.label: Database
fields.help: Default database. Its INFORMATION_SCHEMA also backs the account, warehouse, and query-history views.

fields.label: Warehouse
fields.help: Virtual warehouse used to run queries. Metadata browsing works without one.

fields.label: Role
fields.help: Role activated for the session. Leave blank to use the user's default role.

fields.label: Stored password
fields.help: Reusable Snowflake password. The credential identity can also supply the user name.

fields.label: Key pair
fields.help: Unencrypted PKCS#8 or PKCS#1 RSA private key whose public key is set on the Snowflake user with ALTER USER ... SET RSA_PUBLIC_KEY.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, MERGE, COPY, DDL, GRANT, and other write statements.

fields.label: Confirm destructive statements
fields.help: Requires explicit confirmation before writes, DDL, grants, and session-state statements execute.

fields.label: Query timeout
fields.help: Also applied as the session STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_IN_SECONDS.

fields.label: Query history window
fields.help: How many recent queries INFORMATION_SCHEMA.QUERY_HISTORY returns before filtering, sorting, and paging.

fields.label: Metrics interval
fields.help: Poll cadence for the live credit and warehouse-load panels.

fields.label: Redacted columns
fields.help: Comma or newline separated regular expressions for result columns that must be masked.

fields.label: Transient
fields.help: Transient databases have no fail-safe period and reduced storage cost.

actions.label: Drop database
actions.confirmText: Drop this database? Every schema, table, view, stage, and task it contains is removed and only recoverable within the time-travel retention window.

fields.label: Managed access
fields.help: Only the schema owner may grant privileges on objects in a managed-access schema.

actions.label: Drop schema
actions.confirmText: Drop this schema? Every table and view it contains is removed and only recoverable within the time-travel retention window.

fields.label: Cluster by
fields.help: Comma separated clustering key columns.

fields.label: Target database
fields.help: Leave blank to keep the current database.

fields.label: Target schema
fields.help: Leave blank to keep the current schema.

actions.label: Truncate
actions.confirmText: Truncate this table? Every row is deleted and only recoverable within the time-travel retention window.

actions.label: Drop table
actions.confirmText: Drop this table? Its definition and data are removed and only recoverable within the time-travel retention window.

actions.label: Drop view
actions.confirmText: Drop this view? Anything reading through it starts failing immediately.

actions.label: Drop column
actions.confirmText: Drop this column? Its data is removed and only recoverable within the time-travel retention window.

actions.label: Suspend
actions.confirmText: Suspend this warehouse? Queries already running finish, but new ones queue until it resumes.

actions.label: Resize
actions.confirmText: Resize this warehouse? Credit consumption changes immediately with the new size.

fields.label: Wait for completion
fields.help: Blocks until the resize finishes provisioning.

actions.label: Suspend task
actions.confirmText: Suspend this task? Scheduled runs stop until it is resumed.

actions.label: Run now
actions.confirmText: Run this task now? It executes outside its schedule and consumes warehouse credits.

actions.label: Drop role
actions.confirmText: Drop this role? Every user and role that inherits it loses the access it granted.

actions.label: Grant privilege
actions.confirmText: Grant this privilege? Every user holding the role gains the access immediately.

fields.label: Object
fields.help: Qualified object name, such as SALES or SALES.PUBLIC.ORDERS. Leave blank when granting on ACCOUNT.

actions.label: Revoke privilege
actions.confirmText: Revoke this privilege? Every user holding the role loses the access immediately.

actions.label: Grant role
actions.confirmText: Grant this role to the user? They gain every privilege the role holds.

actions.label: Revoke role
actions.confirmText: Revoke this role from the user? They lose every privilege it holds.

actions.label: Abort query
actions.confirmText: Abort this query? Its work is discarded and the client receives an error.
